title: Triara - I made a free, ad-free browser RPG you can play in ~5 min a day
author: juanludlf
selftext:
Hi,

I built **Triara**, a browser RPG designed around one idea: **your 5-minute daily game**. No ads, no install, just open it and play.

Play here: [https://triara.erandel.com](https://triara.erandel.com/) (still in beta)

https://preview.redd.it/vbgckc54e4lh1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=3791a525e903bf4548976a69f78fe81457ae2d59

**TLDR:** you build and prepare a team of champions, then send them into quick auto-battles. The strategy happens *before* combat (team composition, stats, skills, pets), so each session is short.

A bit more depth for those who want it: 8 champion classes, 200+ champion designs, active/passive skills (AoE, life-steal, shields, counters…), pets, ranked PvP arena, exploration zones with loot, and crafting. 

For now, only available in English and Spanish.

It's an ongoing solo project and I update it regularly based on player feedback. I'd love to know: does the "5 min a day" loop actually feel that way when you try it? What made you bounce, if anything?

Thanks for taking a look! 👍
